result.detail: The main source of uncertainty is the plusarg name for the nonce, which my inputs do not give. If the platform uses another name, the verdict carries MISSING and the run fails; adding one $value$plusargs line fixes it. I chose this over escalating because the rest of the deliverable does not depend on it. Design choices: inputs are driven at the falling edge and sampled 1 ns after each edge, so the testbench does not race the design. The crc is compared both before and after each rising edge, so a mutant with asynchronous reset or a combinational crc fails. The literal known-answer vectors anchor the model independently, so the model cannot pass simply by agreeing with the RTL. Independent review (P6) is still required and must be done by another seat.
